title: Lochlainn is worried

nodes.speaker: Lochlainn McKenna
nodes.text: Good day boss!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good day boss!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're looking distracted. Everything okay?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're looking distracted. Everything okay?

nodes.speaker: Lochlainn McKenna
nodes.text: It's my son, Iann. He's coughing his lungs out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's my son, Iann. He's coughing his lungs out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you seen R.M Alken?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you seen R.M Alken?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Kids are hard work...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Kids are hard work...

nodes.speaker: Lochlainn McKenna
nodes.text: Of course. But the boy has had problems breathing since he was a baby. We spend more money on medical treatment than rent.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course. But the boy has had problems breathing since he was a baby. We spend more money on medical treatment than rent.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is it worse this time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is it worse this time?

nodes.speaker: Lochlainn McKenna
nodes.text: It is, but there's not much we can do. Oxyphiles aren't common outside the Spire. Sufferers often don't make it past puberty.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It is, but there's not much we can do. Oxyphiles aren't common outside the Spire. Sufferers often don't make it past puberty.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait... Did you get a second opinion?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait... Did you get a second opinion?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wait... Did you get a second opinion?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wait... Did you get a second opinion?

nodes.speaker: Lochlainn McKenna
nodes.text: And a third and a fourth. It's pretty clear. Without the mask, Iann won't make it another year.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And a third and a fourth. It's pretty clear. Without the mask, Iann won't make it another year.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sorry Lochlainn. I'd give you more if I could afford it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry Lochlainn. I'd give you more if I could afford it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm sorry Lochlainn. I'd give you more if I could afford it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm sorry Lochlainn. I'd give you more if I could afford it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Children shouldn't suffer like that. Would another 500 help?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Children shouldn't suffer like that. Would another 500 help?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Children shouldn't suffer like that. Would another 500 help?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Children shouldn't suffer like that. Would another 500 help?

nodes.speaker: Lochlainn McKenna
nodes.text: The only thing that could solve the problem costs 200,000 Lims, boss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The only thing that could solve the problem costs 200,000 Lims, boss.

nodes.speaker: Lochlainn McKenna
nodes.text: And they come at a price tag of 200,000 Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And they come at a price tag of 200,000 Lims.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's a lot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a lot.

nodes.speaker: Lochlainn McKenna
nodes.text: Yeah. In the Spire where most Oxyphiles live, it's probably a small expense. And the clean air up there means they don't always need treatment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. In the Spire where most Oxyphiles live, it's probably a small expense. And the clean air up there means they don't always need treatment.

nodes.speaker: Lochlainn McKenna
nodes.text: In the Spire, it's an annoyance. Down here, it's a black curtain waiting to fall.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In the Spire, it's an annoyance. Down here, it's a black curtain waiting to fall.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: 200,000 Lims? That's insane!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 200,000 Lims? That's insane!

nodes.speaker: Lochlainn McKenna
nodes.text: So thanks for the offer, but I guess that's more than you have in your pocket right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So thanks for the offer, but I guess that's more than you have in your pocket right now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So now we know the value of life: 200,000 Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So now we know the value of life: 200,000 Lims.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So now we know the value of life: 200,000 Lims.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So now we know the value of life: 200,000 Lims.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Actually I know someone who owns a mask like that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Actually I know someone who owns a mask like that.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Actually I know someone who owns a mask like that.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Actually I know someone who owns a mask like that.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can ask around about a cheaper alternative?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can ask around about a cheaper alternative?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I can ask around about a cheaper alternative?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I can ask around about a cheaper alternative?

nodes.speaker: Lochlainn McKenna
nodes.text: I appreciate that boss. My family was close to giving up, but we just gotta try anything we can.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I appreciate that boss. My family was close to giving up, but we just gotta try anything we can.

nodes.speaker: Lochlainn McKenna
nodes.text: Living down here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Living down here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yes, but born in the Spire. Must be richer than I thought.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, but born in the Spire. Must be richer than I thought.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yes, but born in the Spire. Must be richer than I thought.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yes, but born in the Spire. Must be richer than I thought.

nodes.speaker: Lochlainn McKenna
nodes.text: Maybe you could talk to her? Maybe she has a contact for getting a cheaper mask?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe you could talk to her? Maybe she has a contact for getting a cheaper mask?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll ask.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll ask.
